$comment: The coverage each country grouping's members must hold, read by `readGroupingRequirements` in `groupings.ts`. A tier lists the columns every member must have; `debt` is the count of missing member cells measured on the date in `debtMeasuredOn`, and the `grouping-coverage` health check fails when a tier's count rises above it and warns when it falls, so the number can only fall. A grouping with no tier is reported and holds no requirement.
$comment_memberJurisdictions: A grouping member whose code is neither ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 nor a jurisdiction code the coverage page enumerates is read through the jurisdictions its publisher states it covers. A cell of such a member is held only when every one of those jurisdictions holds it. A member code absent from this table and from the jurisdiction list is reported as unreadable, and a tier counts each of its required cells as missing.
